title: Edit Recorded Steps
description: Atomically clean a stopped single-recording draft before save: remove incorrect exploration or redundant steps, change recorded form values or anchored inserted text, and move a step before another step on the same page. Targets remain those captured by the recorder.
guidance: Navigation effects stay attached to their gesture. Cross-page moves, arbitrary selectors, scripts, paths and URLs are not accepted. No page action or workflow execution occurs. Read the steps again after each edit; finish naming and save only after the original task is done. Do not run the newly saved workflow.

wizardToken.description: Its ownership token; pass it after a connection renewal.

expectedRevision.description: The current recording draft revision; an outdated revision refuses the edit.

edits.description: Ordered edits applied as one atomic batch.

operation.description: remove: the step and its navigation effects. move-before: the step moves before beforeStepId, on the same page. set-value: a recorded form value or anchored inserted text becomes value (steps with editableValue true).

stepId.description: An opaque stepId returned by recording.steps, never an action id or selector.

beforeStepId.description: move-before only, required there: the stepId the step moves before.

value.description: set-value only, required there: the corrected value from the user task; empty clears the field on replay.

items.description: One edit: a removal, a move within one page, or a form value change.

revision.description: The current recording draft revision; an outdated revision refuses the edit.

outputSchema.description: The new draft revision; no workflow was run.
